exports.name: SearchBoxComponent
exports.summary:
An expandable search input that collapses to a single icon when not in use, with
built-in debounced search/clear/blur events. Implements `ControlValueAccessor`.
exports.summaryZh: 一个可展开的搜索输入框，不使用时收起为单个图标，内置防抖的搜索/清空/失焦事件。实现了 `ControlValueAccessor`。

inputs.name: config
inputs.description:
Config object applied via {@link Dui.apply}; can set `hasDefault`/`defaultGrp` to
start with the input expanded.
inputs.descriptionZh: 通过 {@link Dui.apply} 应用的配置对象；可设置 `hasDefault`/`defaultGrp` 使输入框初始为展开状态。

inputs.name: backIcon
inputs.descriptionZh: 收起状态下显示的图标。

inputs.name: debounce
inputs.description: Debounce (ms) before `searchDebounce` fires after typing stops.
inputs.descriptionZh: 停止输入后，多久（毫秒）触发一次 `searchDebounce`。

inputs.name: alwaysVisible
inputs.description: Keeps the input expanded at all times instead of collapsing to just an icon.
inputs.descriptionZh: 输入框始终保持展开，而不是收起为一个图标。

inputs.name: value
inputs.descriptionZh: 输入框当前值（`ControlValueAccessor` 绑定值）。

outputs.name: searchDebounce
outputs.description: Output event emitter `searchDebounce` (`EventEmitter<string>`) firing when search debounce occurs.
outputs.descriptionZh: 停止输入 `debounce` 毫秒后发出当前输入值。

outputs.name: onSearch
outputs.description: Output event emitter `onSearch` (`EventEmitter<string>`) firing when on search occurs.
outputs.descriptionZh: 触发搜索时（如按下回车）发出当前输入值。

outputs.name: onClear
outputs.description: Output event emitter `onClear` (`EventEmitter<void>`) firing when on clear occurs.

outputs.name: blurSearch
outputs.description: Output event emitter `blurSearch` (`EventEmitter<void>`) firing when blur search occurs.
outputs.descriptionZh: 输入框失去焦点时发出。

outputs.name: onUserDefined
outputs.description: Output event emitter `userDefined` (`EventEmitter<string>`) firing when on user defined occurs.
outputs.descriptionZh: 由 `config` 中的自定义回调触发时发出（用户自定义行为）。

outputs.name: onSearching
outputs.description: Output event emitter `onSearching` (`EventEmitter<boolean>`) firing when on searching occurs.
outputs.descriptionZh: 搜索框展开/收起状态切换时发出。

methods.name: init
methods.description:
Applies the given config's properties onto this component, expanding the input by
default if `hasDefault` or a non-empty `defaultGrp` is set.
methods.descriptionZh:
将给定配置的属性应用到本组件上，若设置了 `hasDefault` 或非空的 `defaultGrp`，
则默认展开输入框。

methods.name: searchClicked
methods.description:
Handles a click on the search icon: clears and closes if already open, or focuses the
input if closed; then toggles visibility.
methods.descriptionZh: 处理搜索图标的点击：若已展开则清空并收起，若已收起则聚焦输入框；随后切换展开状态。

methods.name: toggleVisibility
methods.description: Toggles whether the search input is expanded/visible.
methods.descriptionZh: 切换搜索输入框是否展开/可见。

methods.name: handleSearchDebounce
methods.descriptionZh: 内部使用，将防抖后的搜索值以 `searchDebounce` 转发出去。

methods.name: handleSearch
methods.descriptionZh: 内部使用，发出 `onSearch` 并调用 `config` 提供的 `search` 回调（如果有）。

methods.name: handleClear
methods.descriptionZh: 内部使用，发出 `onClear` 并调用 `config` 提供的 `clear` 回调（如果有）。

methods.name: handleBlur
methods.descriptionZh: 内部使用，将失焦事件以 `blurSearch` 转发出去。

properties.name: searchVisible
properties.description: Whether the search input is currently expanded/visible.
properties.descriptionZh: 搜索输入框当前是否展开/可见。

properties.name: width
properties.description: The host element's width (in pixels, unit appended automatically).
properties.descriptionZh: 宿主元素的宽度（单位为像素，会自动追加单位）。

properties.name: search

properties.name: clear
properties.descriptionZh: 由 `config` 提供的自定义清空回调函数（若设置，会在 `handleClear` 中一并调用）。
